locations.name: Nagzari Nallah Intake Grate
locations.dominant_waste_stream: Multi-layer laminate food wrappers & beverage cans

systemic_interventions: Repair broken culvert concrete apron to eliminate stagnant hydraulic vortex
Install upstream floating trash boom 25m above intake grate
Mandate segregated twin-litter bins for commercial retail shopfronts
